title: New Last Days video claim extraction candidates
source: Full time-coded captions obtained using vidIQ; raw source files committed in corpus/ and corpus-streams/
status: Unscored extraction, no independent outcome verification performed
warning: This is a review-ready extract. These are NOT yet ingested into prophecy.db, nor are they all objectively falsifiable. Guest claims and prior retellings must remain segregated. Do not interpret as prophecy hit-rate results.

mentions.claim_text: Brandon says his vision showed Democrats taking control of the US Senate at the 2026 midterm election.
mentions.quote: I saw the Senate flipping blue.
mentions.falsify_match: Certified 2026 US Senate elections result in Democratic control of the Senate.
mentions.falsify_miss: Certified results retain Republican control or otherwise show Democrats did not take control of the Senate.
mentions.notes: Distinct from his subsequent prayer that this NOT happen. No factual result assessed yet.

mentions.claim_text: Brandon says his vision showed Republicans retaining the US House with a very narrow majority in the 2026 midterms.
mentions.quote: I saw the the House barely hangs on and keeps red
mentions.falsify_match: Final 2026 House results give Republicans a majority, with a narrow seat advantage consistent with his wording.
mentions.falsify_miss: Democrats win the House or the Republican majority is clearly not narrow. Define narrow margin separately before scoring; majority party itself is objective.
mentions.notes: Separate claim from Senate result. Explicit prayer to avoid outcomes creates conditionality.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees Byron Donalds winning the Florida governorship, repeating an earlier prediction.
mentions.quote: I see him winning and this is what we're praying for.
mentions.falsify_match: Official Florida 2026 gubernatorial results show Byron Donalds elected governor.
mentions.falsify_miss: Official Florida 2026 gubernatorial results show he is not elected governor.
mentions.notes: Retelling, not first utterance; retrieve original 2025 source before assigning originality.

mentions.claim_text: He says he had seen AOC become politically stronger after Pelosi faded, then speculates whether AOC might become Speaker.
mentions.quote: If if they win the h house, maybe she'll be the speaker
mentions.falsify_match: AOC publicly assumes US House speakership in an ensuing Congress.
mentions.falsify_miss: AOC does not become Speaker, but his 'maybe' makes this speculation, not an independently scored prediction.
mentions.notes: Do not score as definitive prophecy. Transcript speaker explicitly asks a question.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats a vision of exceptional high and low water levels in Venice, Italy.
mentions.quote: unusual low tides, unusual high tides
mentions.falsify_match: Unusually high and low tides at Venice significantly outside normal seasonal oscillations, assessed against measured tidal records.
mentions.falsify_miss: No bounded window, so non-occurrence cannot be conclusively scored. Normal recurring tides do not count as a match.
mentions.notes: Retelling prior prophecy. Beware high base rate of unusual tides and annual flooding.

mentions.claim_text: He links Italy to coming increased volcanic activity.
mentions.quote: increased and volcanic activity is coming in
mentions.falsify_match: A specified Italian volcano shows measured activity meaningfully exceeding its prior baseline; lack of named volcano and period prevents strong match.
mentions.falsify_miss: No bounded period or named volcano, so cannot conclusively expire.
mentions.notes: No location narrower than Italy, no year; weak prediction.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts an earlier claim that an intentionally dispersed severe disease begins at a French train station with spray bottles and rats, then spreads across Europe.
mentions.quote: they will release it in a train station
mentions.time_phrase: October, November, December, January (prior statement, year ambiguous)
mentions.falsify_match: Evidence of an intentional release at a French train station involving the described dispersion methods and a resulting serious Europe-wide outbreak.
mentions.falsify_miss: Without an original anchored date, this retelling cannot be assigned a definite expiry. Ordinary respiratory outbreaks are not a match.
mentions.notes: Earlier claim restated; original dated utterance is required before attaching a window.

mentions.claim_text: He retells a vision in which Russia attacks Poland near Warsaw with a new weapon, prompting broader war and European conscription.
mentions.quote: Russia striking Poland. And I said, It's by Warsaw.
mentions.falsify_match: A Russian military strike near Warsaw using a newly deployed weapon, followed by an identified European draft.
mentions.falsify_miss: Without a prediction window there is no finite deadline; conventional border incidents alone do not count.
mentions.notes: Longitudinal linkage to earliest utterance necessary.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats his vision of US food distribution concentrated at guarded Walmarts behind barbed wire and military vehicles.
mentions.quote: They'll put all the food and wall at one Walmart
mentions.falsify_match: Official emergency rationing distributes food at barbed-wire-secured Walmart facilities with armed guards as described.
mentions.falsify_miss: No bounded window; an unrelated security presence at a store is insufficient.

mentions.claim_text: He reports a spiritual vision that Donald Trump Jr. will undergo a religious experience after his father, with Ivanka also affected.
mentions.quote: Don Jr. He's going to have a baptism of a Holy Ghost experience.
mentions.falsify_match: Donald Trump Jr. publicly reports a specific Pentecostal baptism of the Holy Spirit after his father's comparable public report.
mentions.falsify_miss: Private experience and no dated deadline make absence unverifiable; avoid treating perceived behavior shifts as proof.
mentions.notes: Cannot be objectively tested without voluntary public disclosure.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a vision of a Cuban-appearing man with a silver briefcase, a glass container and four armed men in a white van, with links he attributes to Russia.
mentions.quote: It's in a jar that looks nuclear.
mentions.falsify_match: Independent evidence shows the specific described handoff including distinctive jar/briefcase, four men and white van, with the claimed origin connection.
mentions.falsify_miss: No date, identified people or place, so cannot expire or be corroborated through generic incidents.
mentions.notes: Detailed imagery but lacks a clear falsifiable public outcome.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees '1929' and sharply falling financial charts, oil derricks, Federal Reserve imagery and gold/silver, suggesting a future economic crash.
mentions.quote: I see 1929. I see a flat line.
mentions.falsify_match: A US stock market crash and banking/economic crisis comparable in scale to 1929, with criteria to be defined independently before outcomes.
mentions.falsify_miss: No dated window and no instrument magnitude; cannot conclusively expire. 1929 does NOT mean 2029.
mentions.notes: High priority for future original detailed analysis but weakly testable as it stands.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a black-and-white visual of swaying skyscrapers in New York, without explicitly identifying an earthquake.
mentions.quote: all the skyscrapers are moving like this.
mentions.falsify_match: A real event causing multiple NYC skyscrapers to sway visibly as described, confirmed through footage or structural reports.
mentions.falsify_miss: No deadline; a symbolic depiction cannot be retrospectively equated to any ordinary market volatility.
mentions.notes: Do not assert he specifically predicted an NYC earthquake.

mentions.claim_text: He interprets a contemporaneous vision as a deliberately spread virus that affects pets, people and financial markets, causing a major economic crisis.
mentions.quote: a major shaking of the economy because of a virus.
mentions.falsify_match: Corroborated intentional pathogen release with significant human/animal illness and temporally connected severe economic crisis, including causal evidence.
mentions.falsify_miss: No bounded time window; isolated animal die-offs or ordinary market declines cannot count as complete match.
mentions.notes: Multiple linked details: release, animal impact, human impact, economic impact, causal relation. Assess separately later.

mentions.claim_text: He predicts that Trump will have a publicly apparent Pentecostal spiritual experience before leaving office.
mentions.quote: He'll be a Pentecostal preacher before he gets out of office.
mentions.time_phrase: before he gets out of office
mentions.falsify_match: Trump publicly describes Pentecostal-style baptism in Holy Spirit and speaking in tongues before departure from office.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such public report by the departure date; private experiences remain inaccessible.
mentions.notes: Window assumes full current term to Jan 2029; earlier departure would change effective deadline.

mentions.claim_text: He says Nov 2 into Nov 3 is a significant period but does not specify any event.
mentions.falsify_match: No objectively specified event. Cannot score based solely on a significant day.
mentions.falsify_miss: No outcome was pre-specified. A coincident major news story would not validate it.
mentions.notes: Explicitly not a verifiable event claim; excluded from accuracy numerator.

mentions.claim_text: Guest Max says something related to the US midterm election will happen in the next two weeks but does not identify the event.
mentions.quote: there is something going to happen in the next two weeks
mentions.falsify_match: No specified event; cannot be objectively scored.
mentions.falsify_miss: No specified event; cannot expire as a definite prediction.
mentions.notes: Spoken by Guest Max; MUST NOT be counted as Brandon Biggs prophecy.
